risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (333.4) indicates extreme market stress, strong USD pressures multinational healthcare revenues, and earnings binary event in 14 days compounds downside risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA 9/21 golden cross, supertrend bullish, and hull bullish provide short-term momentum structure with extreme fear sentiment (23/100) offering contrarian entry opportunity near support at 198.89.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below 200-SMA, weak ADX trend confirmation, overbought oscillators (stochRSI, Williams %R), negative money flow (CMF), non-confirming volume (OBV), macro crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 333.4, strong USD), and high earnings risk in 14 days create a toxic risk/reward setup despite technical signals.
